title: How to organize the guest closet | Guest Bedroom
description:
Hanging space for someone else's clothes, plus whatever household storage this room has honestly agreed to carry.

This is the Guest Closet in the Guest Bedroom. About 60-90 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
At least a forearm's width of clear rod with six matching empty hangers on it, a clear floor square big enough for an open suitcase, household bins on the shelf in labelled lidded boxes with nothing loose above head height, and a strip of tape on the rod marking where the guest section ends.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Take everything out and put it on the bed.
Straighten: Give the guest the end of the rod nearest the door and nearest the light, put the household bins at the far en
Shine: Wipe the rod with a damp cloth, because a rod nobody touches grows a fuzz that transfers straight onto a dark
Safety: Anything stored above the rod sits over the head of whoever is reaching for a hanger.
Standardize: Mark the guest boundary physically with a strip of tape on the rod or a hanger stop, so the line is visible fr
Sustain: Every time you take a seasonal bin down from this closet, you check the taped line and the empty hangers befor

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Six matching empty hangers past the tape line, a clear floor square for a suitcase, and every household bin lidded, labelled and below head height.
